'''''Dragonborn''''' is the third major [[Skyrim:Add-ons|official add-on]] for ''[[Skyrim:Skyrim|Skyrim]]''. The existence of this expansion was first alluded to by patch files found in the [[Skyrim:Patch#Version 1.8|1.8 Patch]], and it was confirmed by Bethesda on 5 November 2012 with an official announcement trailer. ''Dragonborn'' takes place on the island of [[Lore:Solstheim|Solstheim]], first visited many moons ago during ''[[Bloodmoon:Bloodmoon|Bloodmoon]]''. The add-on's plot tasks you with uncovering the identity of the person seemingly controlling the entire population of the island, and stopping them. 
{|
|
:''With this official add-on for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, journey off the coast of Morrowind, to the island of Solstheim. Encounter new towns, dungeons, and quests, as you traverse the ash wastes and glacial valleys of this new land. Become more powerful with new shouts that bend the will of your enemies and even tame dragons. Your fate, and the fate of Solstheim, hangs in the balance as you face off against your deadliest adversary – the first Dragonborn.'' —[http://marketplace.xbox.com/en-US/Product/The-Elder-Scrolls-V-Skyrim-Dragonborn-English/2f3ecc32-1497-4320-bae0-076a314c80d6 Official Summary]
|}{{NewLeft}}

==Notes==
* ''Dragonborn'' was subject to a 30-day exclusivity deal with Microsoft, during which it was only available on the Xbox 360. In February 2013, it was released on both PC and PS3.
* The [[Skyrim:Music#Dragonborn|soundtrack]] that plays on Solstheim contains several pieces from the ''[[Morrowind:Morrowind|Morrowind]]'' [[Morrowind:Music|soundtrack]].
